title: feat(uneqk): k equals t on 27 of 2000 mixed-t stars
science: Negative that costs the #6681/#6675 route its cheapness, not a probe cell: the occupied-NN count k is NOT the lock-tick t. Over a 2000-star prefix of mixed-t unequal-radius weight-4 unread stars, only N_eq=27 have k=t (~1.4%); lex-first disagreement at star 1 (radii (2,1,2), v=(-3,-3,-1)) has t=(1,1,2,2) vs k=(3,3,2,2), and the uneqrad breaker itself - star 21, the very host #6675/#6681 rely on - disagrees with t=(1,1,3,2) vs k=(3,3,3,2). First equality only at star 342. So the one age bit #6681 needs is genuinely EXTRA information not recoverable from nearest-neighbour occupancy, and the 27 coincidences are a listing, not a law.
verdict_pair: none stated (no reverse/face verdicts in the diff)
